verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's evidence covers one-time document verification, selfie matching, SSN validation, and webhook-based verification-session outcomes, but there is no mention of watchlist/sanctions screening or continuous re-screening of previously verified users against watchlist updates. This is a plausible axis for an identity-verification product (competitors like Persona/Onfido offer ongoing AML monitoring), so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
